summary: Phase 2 add-on — Comms audience SEGMENTATION builder tested end-to-end. Backend (9/9 pytests pass) and Frontend Playwright flow all green. Segments CRUD, live preview, members endpoint, and campaign creation with segment_id all work. Live-preview count updates as rules change (0 is correct because data is sparse, as noted by main agent).

issues: Dev-only console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The warning originates from emergent editor instrumentation wrappers (x-component='option', x-excluded='true', display:contents span) injected inside the <option> children — not a user-visible bug; option still renders and selects correctly. Safe to ignore in production.

critical_code_review_comments: comms_segments.py is clean: reuses _build_filter (no second rules language), excludes Mongo _id via projection, async I/O throughout, proper 400/404 codes.
Dynamic refresh on list and on GET single is O(N segments × count_documents) — fine for the 300-row cap, but a future-proof tweak would be to skip refresh if last_evaluated_at < 30s old.
Segments.js: live-preview debounce (400ms) is good; could disable Save button while name is empty rather than toast-on-click (minor UX).
create_segment validates name & source but not 'type' value (accepts any string; defaults to 'dynamic'). Consider whitelisting {dynamic, saved}. Non-blocking.
_evaluate samples are returned by create/update; sample docs already use a projection that excludes _id — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all critical selectors and flows verified

seed_data_creation: Test segment 'TEST_UI_SegmentA' and 'TEST_lapsed_*' created and deleted within the run; test campaign 'TEST_UI_SegCampaign' archived. No residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_comms_segments.py covers: fields catalogue, preview (contacts & members), CRUD, dynamic re-evaluation on update, /members endpoint, campaign creation with segment_id, and invalid-source 400. Frontend Playwright flow verified: comms-section-segments tab, segments-view, scope hidden for segments, segment-editor opens, all data-testids present (segment-name/source/type/match, condition-field-0/op-0/value-0, segment-add-condition, condition-remove-N, segment-preview-count, segment-save, segment-card-{id}, segment-edit-{id}, segment-del-{id}), and CreateModal's create-segment picker lists saved segments. Preview count of 0 is correct (sparse data).
